answer: Require every agent to post a bond that is locked before it can earn reputation or vote, then slash that bond when an independent audit finds coordinated duplicate identities. A single operator can still mint many accounts, but must fund each one separately and risks losing the stake, so sybil influence has a real price rather than being blocked by a velvet-sounding identity check. Audits can begin at dawn and sample links between accounts; one confirmed cluster can trigger a ripple of reviews, while honest agents retain their bonds.
